heading: A bit about who I am
paragraphs: I'm a Frontend Engineer with 4+ years of experience building fast, responsive and accessible web applications with React.js, Next.js and TypeScript.
I've worked on numerous projects across e-commerce, fintech and healthcare, turning complex requirements into clean, intuitive interfaces and writing code that other developers enjoy working with.
Right now I'm expanding into backend development so I can grow into a well-rounded full-stack engineer.
